name: Web Content Diff Checker API
shortDescription: LCS diff between two page snapshots — similarity %, add/remove counts, op list, unified diff
description: Agent-native text diff computed with a real LCS algorithm — no LLM. /diff compares two versions of a page body (or any text) in line or word mode and returns a Sørensen–Dice similarity %, added/removed/unchanged counts, an op-by-op change list, and a unified-diff string. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and change-magnitude guidance (minor edit vs substantial change vs different document). Deterministic, confidence 1.0; you supply both texts so there is no fetch to time out.
